v24_changes: added validated CYBOS 1m/5m raw archives and QA
deduplicated provider audit for production use
corrected Samsung Epis Holdings canonical KRX short code from project 000126 to official alphanumeric 0126Z0
superseded_inputs: kospi100_174_full_history_ohlcv_v21.csv is not a production input because v24 contains the later corrected v23-derived full-history panel

identity_rules.ticker_type: string; may be alphanumeric; never coerce to integer and never strip letters
identity_rules.canonical_security_id: KRX_COMMON:<canonical_ticker> for the listed common-share line unless an explicit lifecycle mapping says otherwise
identity_rules.samsung_epis_holdings: canonical short code 0126Z0 / provider code A0126Z0; uploaded minute archives are missing this security because the collection list used invalid A000126
identity_rules.display_name: names can change; security identity must not be inferred from display name alone

point_in_time_rules.ranking_universe: only rows with is_member=true and eligible_new_entry=true on the as-of date
point_in_time_rules.pre_entry_prices: feature history only; never ranking/buy eligibility before membership
point_in_time_rules.mechanical_ca_adjustment: apply only when asof_date >= feature_boundary_date; adjust historical feature window to post-event basis using listed price_multiplier/share_multiplier; never overwrite raw OHLCV
point_in_time_rules.ca_reset: for reset events, no rolling return/price feature may bridge feature_boundary_date; start a new feature segment at boundary
point_in_time_rules.rights_issues: technical feature continuity resets at rights-off; economic right entitlement is handled later in Portfolio/Backtest
point_in_time_rules.reorganizations: feature continuity resets; position transforms via successor/distributed-security rules later
point_in_time_rules.post_removal: prices are execution-only; no ranking after membership ends

daily_market_data_rules.daily_price_validity: for model/execution price use require finite positive OHLC plus applicable tradable/eligibility flags; retain raw invalid rows for audit
daily_market_data_rules.suspension_proxy: tradable=false rows are excluded from executable prices; retain raw values unchanged
daily_market_data_rules.after_hours_example_047810_2017_10_11: retain raw volume/value, feature_volume=0 and feature_trading_value=0; do not move volume to prior day

intraday_raw_data.source: CYBOS Plus StockChart, KRX scope as collected
intraday_raw_data.raw_immutability: do not overwrite source csv.gz files; cleaned/resampled/model datasets must be separate derived outputs
intraday_raw_data.file_quality: all 318 files readable; zero duplicate timestamps, required-field missing values, OHLC logic errors, nonpositive price rows, negative-volume rows, and negative-trading-value rows
intraday_raw_data.cross_frequency_check: for all 159 instruments, every 5m bar in the 1m-overlap range exactly equals deterministic aggregation of 1m OHLC, volume and trading_value; zero key/value mismatches
intraday_raw_data.provider_windows: actual range is instrument-dependent; KOSPI100 index is 1m 2024-07-24 09:01 through 2026-08-14 15:30 and 5m 2021-07-07 09:05 through 2026-08-14 15:30
intraday_raw_data.session_rule: do not hard-code every date to identical session hours; preserve actual observed bars and use an exchange calendar/special-session table downstream
intraday_raw_data.resampling: within 1m coverage, derive 5m/10m/15m from 1m when a single canonical derived source is desired; do not double-count native 5m and resampled 5m observations

intraday_information_timing.candidate_selection: t-day daily data may define t+1 candidates only after t close
intraday_information_timing.minute_availability: a minute bar may be used only after that bar has completed; no future high/low/close/volume from an unfinished bar
intraday_information_timing.order_sequence: t+1 intraday information may trigger buy/wait/cancel only as each required bar becomes observable
intraday_information_timing.same_bar_barriers: when stop and target are both crossed inside a bar and order is unknowable, apply a predeclared conservative rule
intraday_information_timing.daily_intraday_alignment: retain all minute data, but combined Ranker+Entry training may use only observations for which all required daily features, t+1 minute inputs, labels, and holding-period outcomes exist. Current daily production ends 2025-12-30, so later minute bars cannot silently extend the combined training sample.

one_minute_tradable_member_day_coverage_.missing: 0126Z0 Samsung Epis Holdings, 12 days; collection identifier bug, not delisting survivorship

five_minute_tradable_member_day_coverage.missing: 003410 Ssangyong C&E 722 days plus 0126Z0 Samsung Epis Holdings 12 days

intraday_coverage_and_bias.selection_bias_assessment: small by member-day share but non-random. 5m missingness is concentrated in a later-delisted security, so 5m results must be described as minute-data-covered subset results. 1m missingness is negligible in share but includes a newly listed alphanumeric-code security until backfilled.
intraday_coverage_and_bias.other_failed_securities: the other 14 failed provider codes have zero KOSPI100 member-day overlap with the applicable uploaded minute windows through 2025-12-30; they do not directly remove intraday training member-days
intraday_coverage_and_bias.training_rule: never treat missing minute data as zero/no-signal. Exclude unavailable security-date observations from the intraday model only, while keeping the security in the historical daily PIT universe/backtest.
intraday_coverage_and_bias.reporting_rule: every intraday train/validation/test result must report security/date coverage and missing-reason counts

model_validation_rules.split: time-ordered validation / walk-forward only; no random train-test split
model_validation_rules.fit_scope: scaling, feature selection, thresholds and model fitting occur inside each train window only
model_validation_rules.overlapping_labels: use purge/embargo when label/holding windows overlap split boundaries as needed
model_validation_rules.baseline: compare minute Entry Timing with next-day open or other predeclared simple opening baseline on the identical covered security-date sample
model_validation_rules.costs: final acceptance uses portfolio results after fees, tax where applicable, slippage, gaps, nonfills and partial fills
model_validation_rules.adoption: minute model is optional and adopted only when OOS/walk-forward portfolio performance or risk control materially and stably improves versus the simple entry baseline

file_roles.core: daily PIT universe, daily stock/index prices, Corporate Action/lifecycle controls
file_roles.controls: machine-readable rules, identifier correction and intraday availability status
file_roles.intraday/reference_raw: provider collection provenance only; raw 700-row audit is intentionally superseded by audit/collection_audit_final_v24.csv
